The '''Dorvalla Incident''' marked a new development in the activities of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] group.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I have been anticipating your visit, Lord Sidious. Though I confess that I had no idea you were aware of events on Dorvalla, much less that the Trade Federation had an interest in the planet."<br />"You will find that there are few matters of which I am unaware, Viceroy. What's more, we have not seen the last of Dorvalla. There is something we will need to attend to in due course.|Nute Gunray and Darth Sidious after the Trade Federation gained the rights to shipping and distribution of lommite ore on Dorvalla|<ref name="Saboteur">"[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]"</ref>}}
As part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] sought to secure his influence on [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], the [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="Saboteur" /> and, in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> saw an opportunity on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. Two rival mining companies on Dorvalla, [[InterGalactic Ore]] and [[Lommite Limited]], had been sabotaging the other's [[Lommite]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] shipments, a conflict to which Sidious sent his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Maul exacerbated the conflict through covert sabotage and deception, causing both companies to lose [[Transport/Legends|transports]], thus inhibiting their ability to deliver ore to their buyers. As a result, Lommite Limited [[Executive officer/Legends|Executive officer]] [[Jurnel Arrant]] proposed that the two companies to merge to become [[Dorvalla Mining]], and arranged for the Trade Federation to represent Dorvalla in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and receive exclusive shipping and distribution rights to Dorvalla's ore. Gunray discussed the developments with Sidious, who assured him that their business with Dorvalla was not over.<ref name="Saboteur" />

With the rise of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front's]] militant wing under [[Havac]] ([[Eru Matalis]]), the Front decided to hire the notable mercenary [[Arwen Cohl]] and his team to engage in actual violent confrontation against the Trade Federation and its allies.

==The incident==
The damage done to the Federation was physically small&mdash;it lost several droids, one of thousands of bulk freighters, a cargo of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite ore]] that was recovered, and a shipment of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]], the most valuable item on the freighter.

However, both Cohl and the Nebula Front's militant wing gained new-found respect in the eyes of those oppressed by the Trade Federation, and were viewed with a new sense of urgency by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] (whose Knights, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], had been present at the attack, albeit undercover).

==Aftermath==
The newly-perceived dangers of the Front inspired [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to order militarization of Federation ships and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to consider taxation of trade routes in response, both of which led to the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]]&mdash;which itself led to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade of Naboo]].

In addition, the stolen aurodium later found its way into the [[InterGalactic Bank]] account of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], an event that sparked a scandal and paved the way to ease his removal from office.
